name: Ride Operator Simulator
desc:
🎢 Ride Operator Simulator 🎢

You run the ride. Check heights, pull restraints, close the gates, and hit DISPATCH! 🚦

😱 Phones catch on fire. Hats fly off. The ride breaks down. Can you handle it?

💰 Get paid for every clean dispatch
⭐ Level up and buy upgrades
👥 Play solo or in a group of 4
🎢 Rides: Full Circle, Snapback, and more coming soon!

🔥 Hard Mode COMING SOON

📱 PC, mobile and controller all work!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to help the park grow! New rides are always free.

llm.loop: operate a coaster: check heights, pull restraints, close gates, dispatch -> get paid per clean dispatch -> level up and buy upgrades -> new rides
llm.objectives: run rides cleanly and handle chaos events
llm.progression: level/XP, cash upgrades, new rides, coaster season pass
llm.instructions: check heights, pull restraints, close gates, hit dispatch; handle breakdowns and fires
unique: first-person ride operator console with chaos events (phones on fire, hats flying)
llm.thumbnails: riders in restraints, the operator control panel ('CONTROL RIDES'), 'MULTIPLAYER' banner
llm.complexity_notes: working coaster rides, control panel interactions, rider NPCs and random events
